digest.component_or_area: ticket creation and event reduction pipeline
propositions: Bug tickets lack a record of which detection channel (canary, CI, review bot, human audit, user report) discovered them, making escape-channel trends unmeasurable.

The detected_by field must be captured at ticket creation via environment variable (REBAR_DETECTED_BY) for automated filers and optional --detected-by flag for agents/humans, with zero user friction or prompting.

Validation normalizes detected_by via strip() + lowercase; empty or whitespace-only values are treated as unset; unknown tokens are stamped verbatim without enum enforcement so new channels require no code changes.

The process_create reducer must project detected_by present-only into compiled state, mirroring existing source_* blocks, such that events without the field reduce byte-identically to the pre-change state (additivity proof).
The optional detected_by field must be declared in ticket_state.schema.json and registered in the env-var documentation registry so the drift gate covers it.
